title: Platform safe-zone stylesheets
what_it_does: Generates a per-platform safe zone (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, ads) as a stylesheet with a [data-safe] text container and a minimum text size, so captions stay out of the app UI.
when_to_use: Any vertical video with text over footage.
why: Small, tested, solves a real problem; the inset numbers should be re-checked against current app UIs before we ship them.
